expectedLearning: Determine whether persistent-carrier transfer can be expressed as a renderer-neutral, typed operation family with native KaTeX endpoints and no overlapping ownership.
allowedWork: Implement the approved carrier-preserving simplification family, canonical two-times-one exemplar, existing add-zero pressure caller, promotion metadata, discovery surfaces, bounded LLM selection, and directly supporting tests and documentation.
disallowedWork: Do not redesign unrelated visual motifs, layouts, lessons, renderers, or public product surfaces; do not broaden the family beyond demonstrated callers; do not alter contributor-fusion behavior.
